Akasa Air launches flights connecting Jaipur to Mumbai and Bengaluru

Akasa Air has launched direct flights connecting Jaipur, Rajasthan, with Mumbai and Bengaluru. The airline will also commence operations from Udaipur on October 15, as part of its expansion plans in the state.
